key_difference: (B) treats any decoded byte >= 0x80 as an error, on the premise that valid UTF-8 was already folded to UTF-16, and on Windows rejects literal (already-decoded) backslashes in the input; (D) instead adds its own UTF-8 decoding path with new traits and only rejects percent-encoded %5C, so a literal '\' passes through unchecked on Windows.
